title: The Halloween Storms — October 2003
description: A series of powerful X-class flares and CMEs triggered a G5 geomagnetic storm. Satellite operations were severely impacted, and aviation was rerouted away from polar routes.
historicalOutcome: The Japanese ADEOS-2 satellite was permanently disabled. Airlines rerouted polar flights at an estimated cost of $10,000–$100,000 per flight. Power grid anomalies reported in Sweden.
